rules.terastallization: enabled (every set has a Tera type)

method.species: validator.validateSet accepts a full set (level 100, Adamant, 1 EV, Tera type Normal, IVs 31, one probe move, one declared ability) naming the species; Gmax placeholder names are skipped (the validator aliases X-Gmax to X + gigantamax flag, which does nothing without Dynamax)
method.selectable: validated species that are not battleOnly formes
method.mega: for every item.megaStone entry (base -> mega): validateSet(base holding stone) must pass; the validator maps the stone to the Mega forme (getValidationSpecies) and runs checkSpecies/checkTagRules on it; naming the Mega forme directly is cross-checked
method.battle_only: non-Mega battleOnly formes whose base is selectable and whose required ability/item/move set validates
method.moves: for each selectable species and each of the dex moves: validateSet with that single move
method.abilities: validateSet per declared ability slot of each selectable species; Mega-only and battle-only-forme abilities added from the in-battle forme records
method.items: validateSet on Garchomp and Charizard holding the item; legal iff both pass

coverage_duoforge.naming: DFI_<KIND>_<NAME> lowercased == Showdown id (closure_tables.h + extended_tables.h, Team C included)
